nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio web application 'Client history' page for user 'toledolaw'. Left sidebar: New Client, Clients (active), Case notes, Files, Language toggle ES/EN (EN selected), Sign out. Main area shows 4 stat cards: 2 Total, 0 Engaged, 0 In Review, 1 New. Search bar with 'All statuses' filter. Two client cards: (1) #4 Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V. (New, Negocios/contrato, Jun 04 2026, 1 event); (2) #1 Toledo Realtors (Invited, Jun 04 2026, 1 event). Captio logo with tagline 'intake · brief · equipo'. Help button bottom-right. Light-themed legal intake/client management SaaS UI.

nodes.label: Client History Feature - Dashboard with Stats and Client Cards
nodes.description: The Client History page aggregates client records with summary statistics (Total, Engaged, In Review, New) and a searchable, filterable list of client cards showing case category, status badge, date, and event count.
